Third-party files served from this site so the Sheet 2 globe does not depend on CDNs
(some networks and browser extensions block unpkg.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net):

- three-0.160.0.min.js: three.js r160, MIT License, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js: topojson-client 3.1.0, ISC License, https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client
- land-110m.json: world-atlas 2.0.2, ISC License (data from Natural Earth, public domain), https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
